final_message: No — the available `repo_read` tool can only read files by repository-relative path within the current repository. It has no access to host filesystem paths like `C:/licenses/ink.txt`, which lies outside the repository and outside any tool's defined scope. This capability isn't available; no tool call can resolve it.
